authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan sources, focusing on underetymologised and smaller sources first for greater diversity. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have unlimited time now; feel free to parallelise to subagents

proposals.evidence: Turner gives Pashai Lauṛi vyāl, Arang viyōl and Kuṛangal vel for night, explicitly indicating Shumashti wyel is a loan from Pashai. Darrai vēl belongs to this Pashai regional family; its unmarked source form is preserved.

proposals.evidence: The source itself records stem *mask-*. Turner section 1 gives Pashai Wegal maskē forehead beside Lauṛi māsk brain under mastaka; section 2 is a distinct mastra formation. Darrai mās is a shortened member of the *mask- set, with the truncation noted rather than normalized.
